title: Chart.yaml
description:
Metadata of a Helm chart deployed with werf. In the main chart `apiVersion`, `name` and `version` may be omitted: werf fills them in.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/deploy/charts.html

apiVersion.description: The version of the chart format.

name.description: The name of the chart. For a dependent chart stored in `charts/`, it must match the directory name.

version.description: The version of the chart, a SemVer 2 version.

kubeVersion.description: SemVer constraints on the Kubernetes versions the chart is deployed into, e.g. `~1.20.3`. The deployment fails if the cluster version does not satisfy them.

type.description: The type of the chart. A library chart holds only named templates for use in other charts and deploys nothing.

description.description: A single-sentence description of the chart.

home.description: The address of the project home page.

sources.description: Addresses of the project source code.

icon.description: The address of an SVG or PNG image used as the chart icon.

appVersion.description: The version of the application packaged in the chart. Informational and unrelated to `version`; quote it to keep the YAML parser from reading it as a number.

annotations.description: Additional information about the chart, uninterpreted by werf and available to other tools.

dependencies.description:
Dependent charts deployed together with this chart.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/deploy/charts.html#including-additional-charts

email.description: The email address of the maintainer.

url.description: The address of a page about the maintainer.

name.description: The name of the dependent chart. For a chart stored in `charts/`, it must match the directory name.

version.description: The version of the dependent chart, a SemVer 2 version or range.

repository.description: The address of the chart repository, or its alias from `helm repo add` as `@myrepo` or `alias:myrepo`. Omit it or leave it empty for a chart stored in `charts/`.

condition.description: A path in the parameters resolving to a boolean that enables or disables the dependent chart, e.g. `mychild.enabled`.

tags.description: Tags that enable or disable the dependent chart together with the other charts having them.

alias.description: The name to deploy the dependent chart under. Needed to add the same chart more than once.

import-values.description:
Parameters of the dependent chart copied into the parameters of the parent chart.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/deploy/values.html

export-values.description:
werf only, in charts with `apiVersion` `v1` or `v2`. Parameters of the parent chart copied into the parameters of the dependent chart.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/deploy/values.html

importValue.description: A path under `exports` in the parameters of the dependent chart, copied into the root of the parameters of the parent chart, or a mapping of the source path to the destination path.

child.description: The source path in the parameters of the dependent chart.

parent.description: The destination path in the parameters of the parent chart.

exportValue.description: A path under `exports` in the parameters of the parent chart, copied into the root of the parameters of the dependent chart, or a mapping of the source path to the destination path.

parent.description: The source path in the parameters of the parent chart. The root of the parameters cannot be exported.

child.description: The destination path in the parameters of the dependent chart. An empty path or `.` is the root of the parameters, into which only a dictionary can be copied.
